caption: The drawing is rendered in black ink on a beige or light tan background, depicting an upright cylindrical post standing on a paved surface. The post is 37 inches tall as indicated by a measurement along its left side. At the top of the post is a sculpted dog's head facing forward, detailed with facial features and ears. The post has a rounded base and a flared section just below the dog's head, resembling ornamental architecture. The paving consists of rectangular stones arranged in a slightly staggered pattern. At the bottom of the illustration, centered beneath the main image, the text “IRON HITCHING POST” is written in uppercase letters. The composition is enclosed within a rectangular frame drawn near the edges of the image.
title: Cast Iron Hitching Post
